question: For a NBFC- MFI, the maximum variance permitted for individual loans between the minimum and maximum interest rate_____.

options.text: cannot be less than 2 per cent
cannot be less than 4 per cent

solution:
The correct answer is __**cannot exceed 4 per cent**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NBFC MFI** will ensure that the average interest rate on loans during a financial year (FY) does not exceed the average borrowing cost during that FY plus the margin, within the prescribed cap.</li&g
